Title: Public Preview: Jobs API to support bulk import in Azure Digital Twins

Body.Content:
Azure Digital Twins now offers a new way of ingesting data through Import Jobs API.  Azure Digital Twins already supported the API to create new models, twins and relationships, but now with this public preview release, you can ingest large twin graphs into Azure Digital Twins with enriched logging and higher throughput, which in turn enables simulation scenarios, faster setup of new instances and automating data import workflows for customers. This eliminates the need of multiple requests using digital twins API to ingest a large data set along with handling errors and retries.

To learn more about this feature, please visit Enable Simulation Scenarios through Azure Digital Twins Jobs API for Import.
